text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi—
Wh-Wh-What should I do~?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan...?
What is it, what is it? Did something happen!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I'm planning to enter a pair eating contest
called 'Carry and Eat, Ready, Set, Bowl!'—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My partner Cesario-san couldn't make it~!
And I came here wicked hungry too, no fair~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I see... Wait, could I
enter in their place instead?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? Having you around is worth a hundred people...
No, a thousand people, Tsuru-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, leave it all to me!
I'm aiming for victory with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting!
In "Carry & Gobble Ready, Set, Bowl!", the role of the "Eater" is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
You'll split up with a 'Server' to carry the food and combine your strengths for this contest!
Which pair will emerge victorious?! Ready, set, BOWL!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So I just need to serve a lot of food, right!
All right, gotta hurry!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Let's go with this dish!
Hang on, Spe-chan, I'll make this right away—
choice_data_list: Wait! It's good to be mindful of your stride frequency.
Wait! It's good to be mindful of your stride frequency.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Does that mean I should
increase my leg cadence...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since this is a sandy beach, there's little rebound.
That's why minimizing contact time with the ground
should make for efficient running... or so I told her.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed...!
Understood, I'll give it a try!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's true, the sand isn't catching my feet at all...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can run with all my might!
Let's keep on going—!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff*...! Not yet!
I've gotta bring this to Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still...
are my arms getting a little tired...?
choice_data_list: Changing your grip should shift the muscle load.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! If I carry it the same way,
I'll end up using the exact same muscles...!
Okay, I'll try holding it differently!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
she carried the food with all her might.
However, as the competition progressed—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
With only a little time left, the Spe-Tsuru pair,
who had a commanding lead, suddenly slow down!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*...... *gasp*......
*cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ts-Tsuru-chan!?
Could it be, your limit... !?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's okay to take a break! You're still in the lead,
and you don't have to push yourself to win—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, we've put on plenty of a show so far.
...However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Precisely because this might be her only chance, she gave it everything she had in her challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There may have been times when she pushed past her limits.
However, that was simply the result of staying true to her convictions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then I want you to hit her with everything you've got.
What we should be doing right now isn't worrying about her—"
choice_data_list: Squeeze out every last drop! Tsuyoshi!
Let's squeeze out every last drop! Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...
O-Of course...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I won't give up... I'll reach... Spe-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi presents a parfait!
Special Week downs it in the blink of an eye, and—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The winners are the Spe-Tsuru pairーーー!
A margin of just one plate over 2nd place!
That final dessert sealed the dealーー!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay! It's all thanks to... thanks to Tsuru-chan giving it her all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh... I...
I gave it everything I had right to the very end, didn't I...!
choice_data_list: As her trainer, I'm so proud
Good work! Let's get some good rest after this.
I'm glad our duo won the championship.
I'm glad our duo won the championship.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh... I...
I gave it everything I had right to the very end, didn't I...!
choice_data_list: As her trainer, I'm so proud
Good work! Let's get some good rest after this.
I'm glad our duo won the championship.
I'm glad our duo won the championship.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san...
Ahaha, the pleasure's all mine.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because... you pushed me forward,
so I was able to give it my all until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! That's really nice.
It feels like you're both supporting each other!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Because you're the Trainer
I rely on more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
N-No... Something like this...
is really nothing, so...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ts-Tsuru-chan!?
Your eyes are rolling back, hang in thereee!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Still... full of... vi... gor...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!
Yes, after all, this is the Spe-Tsuru duo!
If we're gonna do it, we've gotta go all out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You were so dependable!
Well then, how about trying a different competition next time?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about a quiz tournament!
Let's aim for victory together!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I like that! Even if it's a quiz,
I'll take it on with all my heart and soul!
